data.name: Necromantic Servant
data.description: As a standard action, you can expend 1 point of inspiration to raise a single human skeleton (Pathfinder RPG Bestiary 250) or human zombie (Bestiary 288) from the ground to serve you for %1 minutes or until it is destroyed, whichever comes first. This servant has %2 hit points. It also has a %3 base attack bonus and gains a +%4 bonus on damage rolls.|10*InvestigatorLVL|HP/2|TOTALAB|InvestigatorLVL/2

raw_tokens.value: As a standard action, you can expend 1 point of inspiration to raise a single human skeleton (Pathfinder RPG Bestiary 250) or human zombie (Bestiary 288) from the ground to serve you for %1 minutes or until it is destroyed, whichever comes first. This servant has %2 hit points. It also has a %3 base attack bonus and gains a +%4 bonus on damage rolls.|10*InvestigatorLVL|HP/2|TOTALAB|InvestigatorLVL/2

Whenever the necromantic servant would be destroyed, if you are within medium range (%1 feet) of the servant, you can expend 1 point of inspiration as an immediate action to cause the servant to return to full hit points.|100+(10*InvestigatorLVL)|PRECLASS:1,Investigator=5
You can choose to give the servant the bloody or burning simple template (if it's a skeleton) or the fast simple template (if it's a zombie).|PRECLASS:1,Investigator=9
When you take an immediate action to restore your servant, it splits into two servants. You can have a maximum number of %1 servants in existence.|InvestigatorLVL/2|PRECLASS:1,Investigator=13
The servant gains a teamwork feat of your choice.|PRECLASS:1,Investigator=17
